descricao_original: A section through the head of the epididymis illustrates efferent ducts, coiled into coni vasculosi, lying adjacent to the duct of the epididymis. The efferent ducts can be identified by the scallopy profile of their lumens. The lumen of the duct of the epididymis, however, has a very smooth outline. 40x
